visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair wearing a red camouflage-patterned hoodie stands in an indoor study. He speaks directly to the camera with an animated facial expression, gesturing with his hands. Behind him, warm-lit wooden shelves are visible, densely packed with various anime figurines, books, and merchandise, creating a cluttered yet organized backdrop. (2) The man brings a small blue-and-white medicine box and a yellow tissue package close to the camera lens for a detailed view. He then retrieves a cotton swab and a small white plastic bottle. He unscrews the cap and carefully dispenses a drop of clear liquid onto the tip of the swab while maintaining a focused gaze. (3) The scene cuts briefly to an empty shelf background while red text appears on screen. Returning to the character, he pulls down his lower lip with his fingers to expose several white circular ulcerated spots. He then displays a tube of oral ointment and a pink box of Japanese medicinal patches to the viewer. (4) In a close-up framing, the man holds the saturated cotton swab near his open mouth. He appears tense as he slowly moves the swab towards his inner lip. The lighting remains bright and consistent, highlighting the texture of his skin and the specific details of the medicinal applicator and the ulcerated tissue. (5) Upon applying the medicine, the man's face contorts into a grimace of extreme pain. He tightly shuts his eyes, furrows his eyebrows, and opens his mouth wide. The camera captures his rapid physical withdrawal and head movements as he reacts to the intense stinging sensation, followed by a fast-forwarded sequence of him clutching his head. (6) The video concludes with the man showing a close-up of the treated area, which now has a distinct white coating. He appears physically exhausted, with visible beads of sweat on his forehead. He continues to speak to the camera, gesturing with his hands to summarize the experience while leaning against a desk.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documentation explores a popular 'urban legend' regarding a painful mouth ulcer treatment. The creator uses themselves as a test subject to demonstrate the extreme physical pain associated with the product, providing both information on the treatment's appearance and entertainment through their dramatic reaction.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video is framed as a personal experiment/challenge to test a painful legend rather than a promotional advertisement.
